historical_reviews.deepseek: Reads ACS text but cannot prove the intended isolation boundary or whether SrcValid is supported and applicable on that function.
historical_reviews.gpt_v2: Correctly requires the device role, full ACS capability/control output, secure transport and a policy owner.
historical_reviews.history: Exact-code/source search found no earlier V3.1 record for this identity.
historical_reviews.v3_1: ACSCtl bits are valid only relative to the ACS capability implemented by a particular upstream/downstream component. SrcValid alone cannot demonstrate the complete routing/isolation posture when the approved policy also depends on Translation Blocking, P2P redirect, upstream forwarding or egress control.

original_test_intent: Verify that ACS is configured as required for the intended PCIe component and isolation boundary.
original_method: Authenticate the exact SUT, resolve an owner-approved domain-qualified BDF and port/device role, collect complete verbose lspci identity plus ACS capability and control fields with exit status, parse supported and enabled bits, and compare every role-applicable control to the approved ACS policy without changing configuration.
manual_activity: A platform/security owner confirms the isolation boundary and role-specific ACS bit policy, then dispositions unsupported or mismatched controls.
required_inputs: Required SrcValid and related ACS bits
safety_requirements: Collect complete identity and ACS context
Do not enable or disable ACS
Do not rescan, reset or write PCIe configuration space
Fail closed on unsupported or ambiguous fields
Preserve raw output and exit status
agent_execution_scope: Collect complete read-only lspci verbose output
Parse ACS capability and control bits
Compare supported/enabled state to the approved role policy
Report missing, unsupported or mismatched controls without verdict
engineer_actions: Approve isolation boundary and port-role mapping
Disposition unsupported capabilities or policy mismatches

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: The query is relevant, but a grep-only SrcValid observation over unauthenticated transport omits device identity, capability support and the other ACS controls that may define the isolation policy.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Through verified-host SSH, capture complete `lspci -s <domain:BDF> -vvv` output and exit status, then compare the role-applicable ACS capability and control bits with an approved policy.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: The PCIE_BUS ACS objective and 40-minute activity remain; full policy and capability context are added.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Represent each intended port/function as a policy row containing supported ACS capabilities, required enabled controls and explicit not-applicable fields, then compare complete lspci evidence.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Expands a binary SrcValid grep into a role-specific capability/control assessment.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: SrcValid+ can coexist with disabled redirect or blocking controls, while SrcValid- may be irrelevant on a function that does not implement the capability expected only on a different port role.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Read-only lspci proves configured bits, not end-to-end peer-to-peer isolation behavior; functional isolation testing, if required, needs a separately governed safe plan.

project_override_considerations: Specify every required ACS bit per PCIe component role, how unsupported capabilities are handled, and whether configuration-state inspection alone is sufficient or separate functional isolation evidence is required.
expected_evidence: Verified target, host key and platform identity
Approved BDF-to-port-role topology and ACS policy revision
Complete lspci verbose output with exit status
Parsed ACS capability and control matrix including SrcValid

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Items, Procedure and Criteria consistently request ACS state against SPEC. The narrow SrcValid example and DeepSeek omissions are incomplete execution detail, not contradictory source intent.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The target role and ACS policy are identifiable owner inputs. Execution becomes BLOCKED only if the intended isolation boundary or authoritative control matrix cannot be established.

review_improvement: Evaluates ACS as a port-role policy rather than treating one grep token as universal proof of isolation.
independent_technical_reasoning: ACS is a capability/control family, not one global enable flag. A trustworthy result must first prove which PCIe component owns the isolation boundary, then distinguish bits the component supports from bits the policy requires; otherwise SrcValid alone can create both false passes and false failures.
